OCRelay 1.1.3

NEW STUDY: CT PERFUSION

• Reads the three volumes from a RAPID-style perfusion summary — ischemic core (CBF<30%), total hypoperfusion (TMax>6s), and penumbra (mismatch) — and fills them into the report. The core/hypoperfusion pick lists and the impression are left alone.

• The mismatch ratio is read but never written: it is used to cross-check the volumes against each other, since mismatch = hypoperfusion − core. A transposed or misread volume is flagged in the review panel, which a plain range check cannot catch.

OB 2ND/3RD TRIMESTER (COMPLETE) — PLEASE READ

• BPD, HC, AC and FL now fill. They never did on the Complete study: the template expected "GA:" and "Percentile:" on each biometry line, which the report does not have, so all four were silently dropped.

• The fetal weight line now carries its percentile, e.g. "324 (50th percentile)".

• Placental cord insertion and cervical length now fill. The MVP line and the per-row gestational ages were removed — neither exists in the report.

• Anatomy pick lists, trimester and the impression are still never written. Rows marked Abnormal or Not Visualized continue to appear in the warning banner.

FIX: MEASUREMENTS WERE WRONGLY SHOWN IN RED

• Since 1.0.95 every OB biometry value appeared red in the review panel on both the Limited and Complete studies. The values were correct — the range check could not read a number that had its unit attached ("6.08 cm"). It now reads the number and ignores the unit, while a slipped decimal such as 265 still flags.
